# [ ] Today's Celebrations

🎞️ **World Day for Audiovisual Heritage**
UNESCO's day, kept every 27 October since 2005, for the films, sound recordings and broadcasts that are lost when nobody keeps them.

⚓ **Navy Day**
Kept in the US on 27 October since 1922, chosen because it is Theodore Roosevelt's birthday; he was born on this day in 1858.

🐈‍⬛ **National Black Cat Day**
A fun day just ahead of Halloween, for the cats that wait longest in shelters because of an old superstition.

## Ways to embrace today

- For Roosevelt's birthday, read the ["man in the arena" speech](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Citizenship_in_a_Republic), then ask yourself on the reading slide whether it agrees with [Moral Ambition](https://hardcover.app/books/moral-ambition)'s case for putting your talent where it does the most good.
- For Audiovisual Heritage Day, find one old family video or voice recording and watch it with the family tonight.
  Read [UNESCO's page on the day](https://www.unesco.org/en/days/audiovisual-heritage) for why it matters to copy them before the tape or the format goes.
- For Black Cat Day, read Wikipedia's [article on black cats](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Black_cat), which explains why they are lucky in Britain and Japan and unlucky elsewhere.

# [ ] Singing Warmup

## Reset: Effort → Air

timer:[2m]

**Sighing "oo"**

- Start around pitch:[C4], slide down to pitch:[G3] and back up
- Vowel: "oo" as in "food"
- Very soft: warm air on glass
- No gripping, no effort

> [!TIP]
> If this feels trivial, you're doing it right.

## Falsetto Rehab

timer:[3m]

**Breathy "hoo"**

- Range: pitch:[G4] -> pitch:[C5]
- Light, airy onset: an owl sound
- Air leads, not cord closure
- No attempt to sound "good"

**Slightly cleaner "oo"**

- Same range (pitch:[G4] -> pitch:[C5])
- Reduce breathiness just a bit
- Still very light

> [!TIP]
> Goal: falsetto becomes something you can choose, not something that stops you cold.

## Mix Builder / Bridge

timer:[4m]

**"Gee" (like "geese")**

- 5-note scale: pitch:[E4] -> pitch:[A4], then move up each round
- Focus area: pitch:[G4] -> pitch:[B4]
- Forward placement: almost nasal, but not quite
- Light, speech-like: no weight added

> [!WARNING]
> If it starts to feel like pushing: reset lighter.

## Target Work: pitch:[A4] -> pitch:[C5]

timer:[5m]

**"Nay" (bratty tone)**

- Short bursts: pitch:[A4] -> pitch:[B4] -> pitch:[C5]
- Think: annoying cartoon voice, slight edge
- Accesses mix without adding weight

**Open vowel shaping**

- Sing "ah", then modify toward "uh" as pitch rises
- pitch:[B4]: not "AHHH", more like an "UH/AH blend"

**"Touch-and-go" pitch:[C5]**

- Tap it and back off: do not hold it
- Think: "visit, don't live there"

> [!WARNING]
> Resist the urge to prove you can hit pitch:[C5].
> That instinct reinforces the exact tension you're undoing.

Train it light, frequent, and boring.
The ceiling rises when you stop pushing at it.
